label: H.R. 8476

latest_action.text: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 660.

selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: The No Antisemitism in Education Act of 2026 requires local educational agencies and institutions of higher education that receive federal financial assistance to treat discrimination motivated by antisemitism as vigorously as they treat other forms of discrimination prohibited under Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. It also mandates that federal agencies, local educational agencies, and institutions of higher education consider the definition of antisemitism outlined in a specific December 11, 2019, executive order when determining if an act or omission was motivated by discriminatory antisemitic intent.

affected_groups.effect: Must treat discrimination motivated by antisemitism as vigorously as other Title VI forms of discrimination and consider the specific antisemitism definition during reviews and investigations as a condition of receiving funds.
affected_groups.group: Local educational agencies and institutions of higher education receiving federal financial assistance

affected_groups.effect: Must consider the specified definition of antisemitism when reviewing or investigating whether acts or omissions were motivated by discriminatory antisemitic intent.

key_provisions: Requires local educational agencies and institutions of higher education receiving federal funds to treat antisemitism-motivated discrimination as vigorously as other forms of discrimination prohibited by Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.
Applies the requirement to discrimination by students, employees, and discrimination stemming from institutional policies.

Requires federal departments, agencies, local educational agencies, and higher education institutions to consider the definition of antisemitism from a December 11, 2019, executive order when reviewing, investigating, or determining violations.
Enforces the provisions using any mechanism available to enforce section 601 of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.
Clarifies that nothing in the section diminishes or infringes upon rights protected by the First Amendment or preempts state antidiscrimination laws.
missing_information: Specific funding penalties or exact dollar amounts for noncompliance are not detailed in the text beyond stating it is a condition of receiving federal funds and enforceable via Title VI mechanisms.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The No Antisemitism in Education Act of 2026 requires local educational agencies and institutions of higher education that receive federal financial assistance to treat discrimination motivated by antisemitism as vigorously as they treat other forms of discrimination prohibited under Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. It also mandates that federal agencies, local educational agencies, and institutions of higher education consider the definition of antisemitism outlined in a specific December 11, 2019, executive order when determining if an act or omission was motivated by discriminatory antisemitic intent.
summary_detail.significance: The bill ties federal funding eligibility for schools and universities to strict and equal enforcement against antisemitic discrimination, utilizing a specific predefined standard for identifying antisemitic intent, which impacts educational institutions and federal enforcement bodies.

title: No Antisemitism in Education Act of 2026
